briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push frontier capabilities amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensified this quarter with multiple frontier releases and record funding. Major labs focus on agentic systems and multimodal scaling. Regulatory pressure mounts on safety benchmarks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning while xAI deployed Grok-4. DeepSeek-V4 and Meta's Llama-4 variants show competitive performance on coding and science tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-teaming reports highlight multi-agent risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates as Microsoft and Google expand data centers. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving for 2027 deployments.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first superintelligent system emerge from a closed lab or open-weight ecosystem by 2028?
